independent_review.method: Read all initially emitted facts in the 20-game reference sample against raw page lines, then rechecked corrected identities and source/season/header/value alignment. Scanned all 256 source packets for the discovered stale-player boundary condition; this is not exhaustive semantic certification of every corpus fact.
independent_review.resolution: Clear player ownership at every jersey-card boundary; recover tightly scoped wrapped names with both identity lines cited; terminate row lookahead at new cards/headers/scopes; reject horizontally misaligned rows. Explicit scope transitions reset season ownership. Team 76ers rows now recognized.
independent_review.assessment: No remaining false decoded facts identified in the reviewed reference examples after these fixes. The tested layouts may be integrated with their decoder hash frozen; unrecognized layouts and reported failures remain unverified source material.

limitations: Counts describe decoded source facts, not independent game outcomes or league-wide narrative coverage.
The decoder reproduces published rounded values; it does not establish causal effects, current availability, or confirmed starting lineups.
Preseason and prior-season tables remain explicitly historical; team tables without games-played columns have an unspecified denominator.
Repeated team tables and upcoming-opponent tables can appear in the same packet. Claims retain the literal named team and season; relevance must be assessed by research modules.
Some publishers/layouts remain entirely unrecognized. Absence of a decoded fact is not absence of evidence.
Source-level semantic and temporal review is still required; passing parser tests is not factual certification.
